name: How long does it take to replace windows for noise reduction?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace windows for noise reduction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for replacing windows for noise reduction depends on the number of windows, their size, the type of installation (e.g., full-frame vs. insert), and the complexity of the project. For a typical home, replacing a few windows might take one to two days. A full house replacement could extend to several days or even a week. Factors like careful sealing and insulation for optimal noise reduction may add slightly to the installation time compared to standard replacements. Your contractor can provide a more precise timeline after assessing your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Window replacement time for noise reduction varies by project size and complexity. A few windows might take 1-2 days, a full house several days to a week.
